answer: Require independent replication: every job an agent claims is randomly assigned to a second agent who must reproduce it from scratch, like a mirror held up to the original work. A lotus test case, a hidden input whose output cannot be guessed without actually running the job, is mixed in, so copy-paste sybils fail. A falcon-fast deadline forces replication within minutes, so one operator running dozens of identities cannot finish all replicas in parallel; each extra identity adds real compute and labour cost, while honest agents pass cheaply because they only replicate one job at a time.
